title: Functions Practice 2
statement:
Module 3 (Functions) covers: transactions, views, functions and procedures, normalization, window functions, subquery patterns. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Views).
hints: Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
